messages:
maria: Quick sync — noticed another vendor auth outage pattern this quarter. putting this thread to track owners + next steps. TL;DR: cloud identity provider flakiness + model-registry auth timeouts hit prod twice in 6 weeks.

devin: Ack. I have the timeline and raw traces, will attach shortly.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-21456. Severity: P2. Summary: external-auth timeouts causing ~3% request failures to hosted inference.

maria: @devin can you confirm if both incidents used the same auth client config? if so we probably have a config drift or token cache issue.

devin: Checking now — both were using the short-lived token flow with `auth-provider-v2`. I see retries spiking in the same 90s window.

ashley: From product side: customers with Dedicated also saw errors when model registry calls failed to fetch metadata. we should list which customers were impacted for outreach.

leo: Suggestion: two immediate mitigations: 1) add transparent local cache for model registry metadata (TTL 5m) 2) multi-auth fallback — try backup auth provider after 2s of failure.

maria: Agreed. Action items:
- Devin -> reproduce and add synthetic test that simulates provider latency (owner: devin, due: 2026-06-10)
- Leo -> prototype registry metadata cache + invalidation (owner: leo, due: 2026-06-17)
- Ashley -> customer impact list + comms draft (owner: ashley, due: 2026-06-12)
- Product-ops -> escalate SLA with auth vendor rep and request RCA cadence (owner: product-ops, due: 2026-06-09)

devin: I'll add a flaky-auth scenario to the e2e harness. plan: inject 500ms-10s latency and validate graceful degradation. will push a PR to `infra/testing` with cases and monitor thresholds.

leo: For fallback logic — we should keep attempts idempotent and limit token churn. Proposal: primary auth (short-lived) x2 attempts, on 429/504 switch to backup provider token for next N requests. Also add metrics: `auth.fallback.count` and `auth.latency.p50/p95`.

maria: Good — add dashboard panels and alert when fallback rate > 0.5% per minute. link to runbook will be updated after we confirm steps.

ashley: For customer outreach, i'll work with sales ops on templated msg + list of impacted orgs. want to avoid over-notifying.

product-ops: Reached out to vendor support, scheduled 1:1 for Tue 2026-06-08. Also opened a billing/SLA review to see credits eligibility.

devin: PR created: `infra/testing#482` — includes synthetic auth timeouts and a small dashboard for failure-injection tests.

leo: I'll start a spike for registry cache. quick sketch: Redis local LRU with per-model TTL, language: Go, embed in catalog service. plz review: `eng-runtime` RFC upcoming.

maria: Next check-in: 2026-06-11 09:00 PT in #incidents. please update the tracker before that meeting. I'll consolidate owners into the postmortem follow-up doc and link it to the incident.

ashley: noted. adding comms draft to `/docs/incidents/vendor-outage-comms.md`.

sre-bot: Reminder: scheduled follow-up meeting in 72 hours for INC-2026-21456.

devin: One more ask — let's add recurring monthly trend review for external deps. maybe a 30-min slot for SRE+Product-ops to review metrics and open action items.

maria: +1. making it recurring. new action: product-ops -> create recurring calendar and agenda template (owner: product-ops, due: 2026-06-15).

leo: I'll add unit/integration tests to prevent regressions on the token caching logic.

maria: Thanks all. I'll post a concise follow-up doc after the vendor 1:1 and close items as they land. :thumbsup:
